verdicts.reason: A: the 'Lima & Co Group' wordmark was moved off its solid navy circle and now sits on the white and gold halftone pattern. The white text on the white disc is almost invisible and 'Group' is lost in the pattern, while the navy circle on the right is left empty. B has the same failure but worse: the brand text is shrunk to a tiny white smudge on the white/gold disc, so it is completely unreadable and the navy area is again empty dead space. A is marginally less bad only because its larger text is partly visible.
